motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council INSTRUCT the Bureau of Street Service (BSS) and the Department of Transportation (LADOT), report back on the following: Current coordination efforts between street sweeping and parking enforcement operations on posted routes; Recommendations to improve interdepartmental collaboration to facilitate simultaneous parking enforcement and street sweeping, including resources needed for implementation; Explore potential technology or equipment that could be utilized to support operations; Data on citations issued for street sweeping, including information on disputed citations issued in areas where street sweeping did not take place Develop policies that would prevent the issuance of parking citations in areas where posted street sweeping does not occur and after street sweepers have passed. PRESENTED BYAA 4/ SECONDED BY: EUNIS SES HERNANDEZ Councilmember, 1st District' AUG 0 1 2025
title: Street Sweeping Policies and Routes / Department of Transportation / No Parking Restrictions Compliance

requests.asks: Current coordination efforts between street sweeping and parking enforcement operations on posted routes, recommendations to improve interdepartmental collaboration including resources needed, potential technology or equipment to support operations, data on citations issued for street sweeping, and proposed policies to prevent parking citations in areas where street sweeping does not occur.
